description: In http_sign.rs, sign_post returns Box<dyn std::error::Error + Send + Sync>. The rsa crate errors that could arise from signing do implement std::error::Error, but the boxing erases the chain. More importantly, from_pem and to_pem return rsa::pkcs1::Error which does not implement the std::error::Error source() chain; callers see only the Display but lose the original cause. This makes debugging key format failures opaque in production logs.
title: http_sign.rs: sign_post drops error source chain
